Waxing Moon in April 2026 The Moon is Waxing on April 1 and from April 18 to April 30. During this time, the sunlit portion of the Moon is oriented towards West (when observed from the Northern hemisphere) and grows each night until the next Full Moon. Waning Moon in April 2026 The Moon is Waning from April 3 to April 16. During this time, the sunlit portion of the Moon is oriented towards East (when observed from the Northern hemisphere) and decreases each night, until it disappears at the next New Moon.
